text:
nina: Heads-up: ACME pilot ask is getting squeezed in. Proposal: ship a very focused 'Optimize Navigator' MVP in 6w that only covers: (1) batching recommendations + simulated impact, (2) prefix/KV caching for chat flows, (3) conservative quant suggestions (int8) with an eval safety net and automated rollback. Need to agree on launch gates and what to push to post-MVP.

arthur: +1 on the narrow scope. Two asks: define the sim-run for batching (how do we estimate customer savings?) and a clear rollback policy for quant.

lia: For sim-run: use 24h trace replay with a small synthetic inflator for peak. Show tokens/$ and p95/p99 delta. Label the sim as "estimate" not guarantee.

mike: Rollback: any automated quant apply must create a model alias and a canary period (5% traffic for 6h). If eval metric drops by default >3% abs (or 10% rel) during canary, auto-revert and send webhook + Ops channel note.

nina: Draft launch gates: 
```
- Batching: UI surfaces top-2 suggestion + estimated tokens/$ saved; simulated run available; one-click apply -> canary 5%
- Cache: instrumentation for hit-rate, per-conversation TTL, and >=25% repeat-prefix compute reduction on internal chat bench
- Quant: int8 presets with preflight eval; auto-revert if eval gate fails twice in 24h
- Alerts: eval-triggered webhook + example failing prompt; default threshold abs 3% or rel 10%
- Docs: ACME onboarding note + tuning guide
```

arthur: Important: shipping "one-click apply" needs guardrails. We should require an opt-in checkbox for "auto-revert on regression" and a preview of affected routes/models. Also we can't block customers from manual override.

lia: Operational limits: we will NOT do per-route baselines or per-GPU micro-profiles for MVP. Offer recommended presets for common hardware and a short explainer about variance.

ops-bot: scheduled job created: RED-2607 - optimize-navigator-mvp, owners: @nina, @arthur. link: https://phabricator.internal/RED-2607

mike: Metrics to include in the pilot dashboard: simulated tokens saved, observed token delta after canary, cache hit rate trends, eval metric time series, and a rollback history table.

nina: Who takes docs + pilot comms? I'll draft the one-pager + ACs and a customer-facing summary. Lia, can you own the sim-run infra and the cache metrics?

lia: I’ll do sim infra and a small replay tool that can run against a short trace. I’ll add a sample trace for ACME to try locally.

arthur: I’ll spec the UI flows and the canary apply UX (confirm modal, rollout slider, preview). Mike — can you scope the eval harness and automation?

mike: Yep, I'll scope a lightweight eval harness that runs the customer's eval set pre-apply and during canary; will emit webhook events and save a sample failing prompt on regression.

nina: OK final: narrow MVP to these three verticals, defer per-route thresholds, long-term retention, and per-GPU tuning. If anyone anticipates a blocker to the 6w window, flag immediately.

arthur: Noted. I expect UI mocks in 3d to avoid blocking.

lia: Will post the replay tool notes by EOD tomorrow.

mike: I'll post a rough eval latency/cost estimate in the ticket by EOD.

nina: Thanks all. Scheduling 30m sync after one-pager is posted.
